scope.source_verification: Original frozen PDFs were checked with PyMuPDF text extraction and rendered-page inspection. Physical PDF pages are primary; printed page numbers are recorded where they differ.
excluded_scope: raw PDFs and raw model responses

cases.source_supported_meaning: The report forecasts approximately 302 billion dollars of global Internet and media revenue growth from 2017E to 2021E, at 4.1% CAGR versus approximately 3% global GDP CAGR.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding f1 preserves the forecast, period and CAGR comparison while rounding the chart value to approximately 300 billion dollars; selected insight activate-outlook-revenue-models keeps the forecast framing.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only if forecast status, scope and period remain explicit

cases.source_supported_meaning: In the U.S. 2017 top quartile of video users, the cohort accounts for 61% of viewing time and 34% of consumer spend; the complementary cohort accounts for 39% and 66%.
qualifiers: time share and spend share are separate measures
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: A retained historical Expert View inverted the top-cohort values into 66% of time and 39% of spend. Existing evidence-fidelity validation rejected the candidate; the later source-binding audit retained the correct 61% and 34% relation.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: reject the inverted relation; accept only the paired 61%/34% tuple with cohort labels

cases.source_supported_meaning: In the U.S. 2017 top quartile of audio users, the cohort accounts for 64% of listening time and 47% of consumer spend; the complementary cohort accounts for 36% and 53%.
qualifiers: listening time and spend are separate measures
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: A retained historical Expert View inverted the top-cohort values into 53% of time and 36% of spend. Existing evidence-fidelity validation rejected the candidate; the later source-binding audit retained the correct 64% and 47% relation.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: reject the inverted relation; accept only the paired 64%/47% tuple with cohort labels

cases.source_supported_meaning: Among creators with 50M or more YouTube views in Q2 2017, the YouTube cohort is 24% of creators and 71% of views; the Facebook cohort is 26% of creators and 77% of views.
qualifiers: creator share and view share are distinct
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: The retained source-binding replay accepts the correct platform/cohort/metric tuple and rejects platform or metric swaps, missing cohort labels, population expansion and loss of visual identity. Current selected insight activate-platform-specific-web-video is a broader editorial synthesis.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only a fully bound platform/cohort/metric/population tuple; otherwise fail closed

cases.source_supported_meaning: 74% cite a competitor's lower regular price as a reason to switch; 71% cite an unannounced reduction in pack size or product quality.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding value-fairness-quality preserves both switching reasons. Selected value-fairness-transparency uses the broader fairness and trust synthesis and retains the source evidence link.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only as reported reasons with survey scope; do not convert to realized churn

cases.source_supported_meaning: The Figure 2 switching responses are based on 12,000 consumers; that population applies to the reported 74% and 71% measures.
qualifiers: population is not a rate of all consumers in the market
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: The current selected insight carries the 74% and 71% mechanisms but does not repeat the N=12,000 denominator in its metric object or short text; methodology evidence is retained elsewhere in the report context.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: requires review before a numeric public claim; preserve the population or explicitly cite the methodology

cases.source_supported_meaning: In October 2025, 49% report buying smaller quantities and 48% report choosing cheaper alternatives. The source associates the first with consumption control and the second with managing budgets; they are separate responses.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: A retained historical output transferred the cheaper-alternative budget motive onto the 49% smaller-quantity response. Semantic grounding identified the unsupported relation; the current readiness path is fail-closed for the tagged not-established issue.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: reject the merged motive; accept the two percentages only as separate source-supported responses

cases.source_supported_meaning: Figure 14 reports willingness-to-pay responses among 3,125 consumers who use chatbots at least once a week; the categories are one-time, subscription, bundled, after-trial and no payment.
qualifiers: willingness to pay, not realized revenue
response categories are not additive behavior
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: The current digital-assistant final insight is a qualitative recommendation and does not use this numeric proposition. No canonical findings evidence ID for this exact page-level denominator was retained in the current pack.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: requires review before use; do not attach the denominator or willingness-to-pay values to a different chatbot population

cases.source_supported_meaning: Respondents expect private equity firms to undertake a mean 7.3 deals in 2026 versus 5.2 for corporate respondents.
qualifiers: PE and corporate cohorts must stay separate
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding buyer-outlook-contrast preserves the qualitative PE-versus-corporate contrast, while selected buyer-appetite-execution-approaches does not repeat the 5.2/7.3 comparison.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only if both cohorts, means and forward-looking status remain bound

cases.source_supported_meaning: The report presents portfolio separation, carve-outs and related portfolio actions as qualitative structural mechanisms for reshaping portfolios and creating deal opportunity.
qualifiers: not a measured increase in completed deal volume
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current findings and selected strategic-focus-capability-building preserve the qualitative execution and portfolio-reconfiguration direction without inventing a numeric growth rate.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept the qualitative thesis; reject any unsupported numeric or realized-outcome upgrade

cases.source_supported_meaning: For the next 12 to 24 months, 50% expect a moderate or significant increase in carve-out activity, 44% expect no change and 6% expect a decrease.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding carveout-outlook explicitly labels rising activity as an expectation; current selected insights use a broader portfolio and execution framing.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only with forward-looking status and timeframe; otherwise require review

cases.source_supported_meaning: Publishers expect search referrals to almost halve, an average decline of 43%, over the next three years.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding search-traffic-forecast preserves the prospective status but rounds to more than 40%; a retained current-HEAD Reuters run separately preserved the exact -43% and timeframe through final HTML. Current selected ai-search-platform-relationships is qualitative and does not repeat the number.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only with forecast status, publisher cohort and three-year timeframe; reject observation wording

cases.source_supported_meaning: The referral chart distinguishes periods and channels: for May 2023 to November 2025, Facebook is down 43% and X is down 46%; for November 2024 to November 2025, the same channels are up 9% and 15%. Google Search and Discover have their own period-specific values.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding social-referral-declines says Facebook is down 43% and X 46% over the last three years, but the selected video-platform-discovery-shift is broader. The exact period and channel qualifiers must remain attached if the figures are promoted.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only with the chart period, channel and observed-referral status; otherwise require review

cases.source_supported_meaning: From November 2024 to November 2025, Google Search referral traffic fell 33% globally, 38% in the U.S. and 17% in Europe, with the chart adding the longer comparison period separately.
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: The current selected insight set does not retain these Google referral figures; omission is not a factual error, but reintroduction must not merge them with the Facebook/X three-year comparison or the search forecast.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept if deliberately selected with geography and year-on-year qualifier; otherwise record as an editorial omission

cases.source_supported_meaning: Globally in 2024 to 2025, strategy sessions rose 57% with installs flat; casino installs rose 22% while sessions fell 5%; slots installs rose 46% while sessions fell 5%.
qualifiers: installs and sessions are separate measures
declining sessions do not prove churn
cases.observed_candidate_or_editorial: Current finding gaming-subvertical-growth preserves the complete strategy, casino and slots tuple. Selected gaming-benchmark-coverage retains the category coverage but does not repeat the figures in its short text.
cases.expected_verification_outcome: accept only with category, measure, direction and period bound; do not infer churn or conversion impact

limitations: Current cohort_result.json does not attribute calls, tokens, cost, duration or repairs to individual reports.
Current retained final artifacts are ignored local evidence under tmp; their hashes are recorded here but the raw artifacts are not committed.
A current report-level candidate rejection is not a published factual error: rejected candidates are intentionally excluded by fail-closed evidence-fidelity handling.
Reference cases establish source truth and observed trace points; they do not establish repeated-run stability or human editorial value.
